projection.name: Lambert azimuthal equal-area, spherical (engine map_route_v1.LAEA), centred on each frame centre, north up
projection.note: pyproj not installed; the engine's own LAEA formulas are used (forward map_route_v1.LAEA, inverse map_modes_v2.inverse_laea). The proj strings are exact equivalents (+R sphere, not WGS84 ellipsoid). Pixel mapping: x_px = (X_m - xmin) / m_per_px, y_px = (ymax - Y_m) / m_per_px.

safe_area_definitions.title_safe: 5% inset each side (labels must stay inside)
safe_area_definitions.pin_safe: per frame pin_inset (fraction of W, H): every pinned stop and region label point must be inside

euro_16x9.use: Map 2 whole route (2a+2b) + Map 1 stations for context
euro_16x9.justification: Whole Fieschi route on one plate: Ireland complete, Britain, Sluis, Paris, Cologne, Milan, Avignon with the Gulf of Lion and the whole Pyrenees chain below it; frame height is set by Malin Head (55.4N) to the Pyrenees (42.4N) plus margins, the 16:9 width then gives open Atlantic to the west (medallion/label calm zone) and the Alps-Po basin to the east.

lonlat_bounds.note: envelope of the frame edge; the frame is a rectangle in LAEA metres, so meridians/parallels are curved inside it

solver.note: minimum width satisfying every pin-safe/geography inset; final = rounded up for comfort, centre = content-centred
